package.description: FREE GPS Software for your Garmin, Magellan or Lowrance GPS

en-US.description: FREE GPS Software for your Garmin, Magellan or Lowrance GPS
en-US.longDescription: EasyGPS is the fast and easy way to upload and download waypoints, routes, and tracks between your Windows computer and your Garmin, Magellan, or Lowrance GPS. Use EasyGPS to back up and organize your GPS data, print maps, or load new waypoints onto your GPS for your next hike or geocaching adventure.
en-US.name: EasyGPS

zh-CN.description: 适用于您的佳明、麦哲伦或劳伦斯 GPS 的免费 GPS 软件
zh-CN.longDescription: EasyGPS 是一款便捷高效的工具，能够轻松实现 Windows 电脑与佳明、麦哲伦或劳伦斯 GPS 设备之间的航点、路线和轨迹的上传与下载。通过 EasyGPS，您可以备份和管理 GPS 数据，打印地图，或为下一次徒步旅行或地理寻宝活动加载新的航点到您的 GPS 设备中。
